اشتغلوا (form VIII)
# اِشْتَغَلُوا (ištaḡalū) /iʃ.ta.ɣa.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِشْتَغَلَ (ištaḡala)
# اِشْتَغِلُوا (ištaḡilū) /iʃ.ta.ɣi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِشْتَغَلَ (ištaḡala)
